buyout_family_live_uq.name: buyout_family_live_uq
buyout_family_live_uq.where: state not in ('voided', 'refused') and student_id is null

buyout_student_live_uq.name: buyout_student_live_uq
buyout_student_live_uq.where: state not in ('voided', 'refused') and student_id is not null

requirement_progress_records_something.name: requirement_progress_records_something
requirement_progress_records_something.value: "requirement_progress"."met_at" is not null or "requirement_progress"."waived_at" is not null

signed_form_evidence_app_records.name: signed_form_evidence_app_records
signed_form_evidence_app_records.value: ("signed_form_evidence"."earlier_company_at" is not null and "signed_form_evidence"."family_id" is null and "signed_form_evidence"."student_id" is null) or ("signed_form_evidence"."earlier_company_at" is null and "signed_form_evidence"."family_id" is not null and ("signed_form_evidence"."student_id" is null) = ("signed_form_evidence"."subject_kind" = 'family'))

volunteer_credit_source_record.name: volunteer_credit_source_record
volunteer_credit_source_record.value: ("volunteer_credit"."kind" in ('checkin', 'staff_checkin') and "volunteer_credit"."signup_id" is not null and "volunteer_credit"."requirement_id" is null and "volunteer_credit"."student_id" is null) or ("volunteer_credit"."kind" = 'outside' and "volunteer_credit"."signup_id" is null and "volunteer_credit"."requirement_id" is not null)

volunteer_signup_filler_record.name: volunteer_signup_filler_record
volunteer_signup_filler_record.value: ("volunteer_signup"."filler_kind" = 'guardian' and "volunteer_signup"."filler_parent_id" is not null and "volunteer_signup"."student_id" is null) or ("volunteer_signup"."filler_kind" = 'student' and "volunteer_signup"."student_id" is not null and "volunteer_signup"."filler_parent_id" is null)
